title: Sisters Holding Baby Outdoors, 1940s B&W Snapshot
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from the late 1940s featuring two young girls dressed up in tailored skirt suits and matching brimmed hats outdoors on a grassy lawn. The older girl is holding an infant swaddled in light clothing, likely for a family event such as Easter or a christening. The photo features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-century prints.
